messages.message: Hi, welcome to Nimbus Telecom. My name is Vikram. How can I help you today?
Hi Vikram. I am really frustrated with my connection speed. It is constantly dropping and I am tired of it.
I need to verify your account first. Please provide your account number and date of birth.
My name is Rohan Patel, account number is 77997185 and my date of birth is 07/02/2002.
Thank you. I see your account details. What is the phone number associated with the account?
It is 99803 58440. Honestly, this service is useless. I want to cancel my plan immediately.
If you cancel now, there is an early-termination fee of 150 dollars. Your final bill will arrive within 30 days.
That is ridiculous! I am not paying that for a service that never worked. I am switching to another provider today.
Trust me, the money will definitely be back in your account by tomorrow.
What money? You just said I have to pay a fee! You are not listening to me at all, this is a total mess.
Is there anything else I can assist you with today? To summarize, you are cancelling and the fee applies. Goodbye.
